title: Variables can change
summary: A TensorFlow Variable holds a value that can be updated. Model weights are usually stored in variables.
introduction: A TensorFlow Variable holds a value that can be updated. Model weights are usually stored in variables. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A TensorFlow Variable holds a value that can be updated. Model weights are usually stored in variables.

blocks.code:
import tensorflow as tf

count = tf.Variable(2.0)
count.assign_add(1.0)
print(float(count.numpy()))
blocks.title: Variables can change

blocks.text: The output is 3.0. assign_add changes the stored value by adding 1.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Assign a completely new value with assign.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A constant tensor and a mutable Variable have different purposes.
For more detail later, use this [TensorFlow further reading](https://www.tensorflow.org/guide/basics).
